text_block_list.text: I'm in the middle of a meeting with Fuji Kiseki, when…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Sorry, my throat feels a little funny today.
choice_data_list: You okay? Did you catch a cold or something?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The thing is, I went to sing karaoke yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They had a lot of songs from minor musicals, so I got carried away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I ended up singing each one as if I were performing on stage, and… Cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I've learned my lesson. It's never good to go overboard, whether it's racing or singing.
